question: If you treat the wind blowing across Earth's surface as a smooth field of arrows, a theorem of topology guarantees that at any given moment there is always at least one spot on the planet where the horizontal wind speed is exactly zero.

question: There exists an infinite list of numbers whose sum can be made to equal any value you choose — 0, or 100, or pi — simply by adding the very same terms in a different order.
anchorText: its terms can be arranged in a permutation so that the new series converges to an arbitrary real number

question: In advanced scurvy (severe vitamin C deficiency), bones that had fully healed years earlier can break apart again at the old fracture site.
anchorText: Teeth loosen, bones break more easily, and once-healed breaks may recur

question: In a clinical trial of critically ill patients, the group whose fevers were aggressively brought down with medication ended up dying more often than those whose fevers were left largely untreated.
anchorText: one trial was terminated early because patients receiving aggressive fever treatment were dying more often

question: Phantom limb sensations — vividly feeling a limb that isn't there — can occur only in people who once had the limb and then lost it to amputation or injury.
anchorText: many people born without limbs also experienced phantom limbs
